next:or:483.hint: 彼女はその箱の端をつかんで持ち上げた
next:or:483.fullSentence: She picked up the box by one corner.
next:or:483.explanation: pick up ~ by one corner『〜の端をつかんで持ち上げる』。
next:or:483.relatedInfo: byは接触点・つかむ部分を表す。

next:or:484.hint: 偶然性を表す前置詞句
next:or:484.question: We found the shop [[by accident on]].
next:or:484.fullSentence: We found the shop by chance.
next:or:484.relatedInfo: どちらもほぼ同じ意味で使われる。

next:or:485.hint: その2つの建物は並んで立っている
next:or:485.fullSentence: The two buildings stand side by side.
next:or:485.explanation: stand side by side『並んで立つ』。
next:or:485.relatedInfo: side by sideは『並んで』を表す慣用句。

next:or:486.question: He finished the job [[by him]].
next:or:486.fullSentence: He finished the job by himself.
next:or:486.relatedInfo: for oneself(自分の力で)との違いに注意。

next:or:487.hint: 彼はいつも何事も規則通りに行う
next:or:487.fullSentence: He always does everything by the book.
next:or:487.relatedInfo: 融通が利かないことを揶揄するニュアンスもある。

next:or:488.hint: 期限を表すbyと継続を表すuntilの違い
next:or:488.question: Please submit this report [[until]] tomorrow.
next:or:488.fullSentence: Please submit this report by tomorrow.
next:or:488.explanation: byは「〜までに」(期限)、untilは「〜までずっと」(継続)を表す。
next:or:488.relatedInfo: Please wait until tomorrow. なら継続の意味になる。

next:or:489.hint: 警官はその泥棒の腕をつかんだ
next:or:489.fullSentence: The officer caught the thief by the arm.
next:or:489.explanation: catch A by the arm『Aの腕をつかむ』。
next:or:489.relatedInfo: grab O by the collarと同じ語順パターン。

next:or:490.hint: 体の部位を見つめる慣用表現
next:or:490.question: She [[looked at me in the eye]].
next:or:490.fullSentence: She looked me in the eye.
next:or:490.wrongPart: looked at me in the eye
next:or:490.explanation: look A in the face[eye]『Aの顔[目]を見つめる』。
next:or:490.relatedInfo: 目的語A+in the+体の部分、という特殊な語順に注意。

next:or:491.hint: 彼は友人の肩をバシッと叩いた
next:or:491.fullSentence: He slapped his friend on the shoulder.
next:or:491.explanation: slap A on the shoulder『Aの肩を(バシッと)叩く』。
next:or:491.relatedInfo: pat A on the shoulder(軽く叩く)との強さの違い。

next:or:492.hint: 優しく叩く動作を表す動詞
next:or:492.question: He [[slapped her on the shoulder]] to encourage her.
next:or:492.fullSentence: He patted her on the shoulder to encourage her.
next:or:492.explanation: pat A on the shoulder『Aの肩を(軽く)叩く』。
next:or:492.relatedInfo: slap(バシッと)より優しい動作。

next:or:493.hint: 彼女は優しく彼の頬に触れた
next:or:493.fullSentence: She gently touched him on the cheek.
next:or:493.explanation: touch A on the cheek『Aの頬に触れる』。
next:or:493.relatedInfo: kiss A on the cheekも同じパターン。

next:or:494.hint: 体の部位にキスする慣用表現
next:or:494.question: He [[kissed on her cheek]] as a farewell.
next:or:494.fullSentence: He kissed her on the cheek as a farewell.
next:or:494.explanation: kiss A on the cheek『Aの頬にキスする』。
next:or:494.relatedInfo: touch/slap/pat A on the +体の部分と同じ形。

next:or:495.hint: 彼らはその商品を原価で売った
next:or:495.fullSentence: They sold the goods at cost.
next:or:495.relatedInfo: 利益を乗せずに売ることを表す。

next:or:496.hint: 完全に相手の支配下にあることを表す慣用句
next:or:496.question: The ship was [[at the risk of]] the storm.
next:or:496.fullSentence: The ship was at the mercy of the storm.
next:or:496.explanation: at the mercy of A『Aのなすがままに』。
next:or:496.relatedInfo: 抵抗できずに翻弄される様子を表す。

next:or:497.hint: 彼は自分の命の危険を冒してその子供を救った
next:or:497.fullSentence: He saved the child at the risk of his own life.
next:or:497.explanation: at the risk of A『Aの危険を冒して』。
next:or:497.relatedInfo: at the mercy of Aと形は似るが意味が異なる。

next:or:498.question: Let's meet [[on]] 5:00.
next:or:498.relatedInfo: 曜日にはon、月・年にはinを使う。

next:or:499.hint: 彼女は15歳のときに絵を始めた
next:or:499.relatedInfo: at a partyのように特定の場面にも使う。

next:or:500.hint: 熱心に取り組んでいる状態を表す前置詞句
next:or:500.question: He is hard [[in school]] this semester.
next:or:500.fullSentence: He is hard at school this semester.
next:or:500.explanation: at school『勉強に励んで』。文脈により『学校で』の意味にもなる。
next:or:500.relatedInfo: at workにも似た『取り組んでいる』ニュアンスがある。

next:or:501.hint: 彼は根っからの教師だ
next:or:501.fullSentence: He is a teacher at heart.
next:or:501.explanation: a teacher at heart『根っからの教師』。
next:or:501.relatedInfo: at heartは『本質的には、根っからの』という意味。

next:or:502.hint: 驚きの対象を示す前置詞
next:or:502.question: She was [[surprised with]] the news.
next:or:502.fullSentence: She was surprised at the news.
next:or:502.relatedInfo: be surprised at Aの形でよく使う。

next:or:503.hint: 私はこの計画が全く好きではない
next:or:503.fullSentence: I don't like this plan at all.
next:or:503.relatedInfo: 否定文を強調する慣用表現。

next:or:504.hint: 現在の状況を表す前置詞句
next:or:504.question: He is busy [[in the moment]].
next:or:504.fullSentence: He is busy at the moment.
next:or:504.explanation: at the moment『今のところ/その瞬間に』。

next:or:505.explanation: call+人+at+電話番号『(番号)に電話する』。
next:or:505.relatedInfo: atは特定の連絡先(番号・住所)を示す。

next:or:506.hint: 怒りの対象を示す前置詞
next:or:506.question: He suddenly [[yelled to]] me.

next:or:507.hint: 溺れる者は藁にもすがる
next:or:507.fullSentence: A drowning man will catch at a straw.
next:or:507.explanation: catch at a straw『藁にもすがる』。ことわざとして有名。
next:or:507.relatedInfo: catch atは『つかもうと手を伸ばす』動作を表す。
